name: Sudoku unique-solution check
prompt: Review the Sudoku generator and confirm it creates a valid board with exactly one unique solution. Add a helper to validate uniqueness and explain any edge cases.

name: Top 10 leaderboard
prompt: Implement a leaderboard that keeps the top 10 scores in localStorage using player name, time, hints used, and difficulty. Sort by fastest time and keep only the best 10 entries.

name: Responsive board styling
prompt: Style the Sudoku board so each 3x3 region has a distinct background color without changing the grid layout or causing shifts. Keep it readable in both light and dark mode.

name: Reject bad Copilot suggestion
prompt: Evaluate a proposed code change critically. Reject it if it adds brittle logic, poor accessibility, or invalid Sudoku state handling, and explain the issue before revising the implementation.
